limitations: Small local synthetic samples are not real-world accuracy
Model choices and separate scripted probes are not interchangeable
Legacy configurations/receipts lack retrospectively inferred policy/provider proof
No qualitative assessment of summary accuracy
Wall-clock latency is local event-recording latency
